pairs.why: The two rovers are practically the same model with the same finish; only small ground details like the crater placement differ, so neither one is closer to the real cards.
Same rover in both, with matching rendering, color and light; the only differences are tiny crater and rock placements on the ground.
A's rover has a visible panel seam and lower housing, so it reads slightly more like a built object, the way the preferred saddles did, while B's body is a single plain block.
B's rover has the panel seam and lower housing, so it is built a little more like a real object, while A's body is a plain soap-bar block.
A has brighter, glowing star nodes, a slight sheen on the rim and a punchier planet, closer to the vivid, readable illustration on the real map and book cards, while B looks flatter and plainer.
B has the brighter star nodes, the rim sheen and the stronger planet, which match the saturated, polished look of the real cards better than A's flatter disc.
B adds rivets, a seam at the nose and ringed nozzle segments, so it is built like a real object as the real bus and bike are, while A is a smooth, toy-like shape.
A has the riveted nose seam and segmented nozzle that give it real construction, while B is the plainer, toy-like version.
